idea.title: SignalScout — Real-time trend scanner for indie hackers

plan.tagline: Scan global trends in real-time without drowning in data
plan.problem: Indie hackers waste hours manually checking multiple sources for trending topics, missing opportunities due to slow or fragmented data
plan.solution: CLI tool that aggregates trending topics from GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit, and Product Hunt into a single real-time dashboard with alerts and reports
plan.target_market: Solo developers and small teams building bootstrapped products who need actionable trend data without complex setups
plan.demo_script: Run `signalscout --demo` to see hardcoded trends in AI tools, SaaS, and indie hacking. Shows top 5 trending topics with source links in terminal output.
